ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this case goes to a human reviewer. No money is refunded and no money is collected today — the disputed SGD 9.50 is held until that review finishes (POL-GEN-03: an escalation is terminal and replaces the ruling).

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The trip record EV-TRIP-02850 puts the booked optimal distance at 14.0 km. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02850 puts the distance driven at 18.2 km — an excess of 4.2 km, or 30.0% of optimal. That clears POL-RD-01's two establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km), so on the figures a deviation is established. But the trace is impaired: it carries a 100-second gap between fixes, from 22:07:31 to 22:09:11, longer than the 90-second limit in POL-RD-07(a). The admissibility pre-pass tagged EV-GPS-02850 IMPAIRED on issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW at weight_multiplier 0.60, and both advocates disclosed that discount.

WHY I CANNOT RULE ON THE MONEY. POL-GEN-02(2) caps my confidence at the weight of the artifact that carries the deciding fact. The fact that the vehicle drove 18.2 km is carried by the impaired trace alone. trip_record.actual_distance_km is, in POL-RD-01's own words, a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement and may not be used for the threshold test; and the fare ledger's 18.2 km (EV-FARE-02850) is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) states is not independent corroboration. No second, independent artifact carries that distance, so the cap is 0.60, not 1.00. The rider's argument that the clean 14.0 km optimal (EV-TRIP-02850, weight 1.0) lifts the cap to 1.00 is rejected: the excess needs the driven distance as well as the optimal, and only the impaired trace supplies the driven distance. A cap of 0.60 is below the platform's 0.70 confidence floor, so POL-RD-10(1) applies and the outcome is ESCALATE.

THE CORROBORATION QUESTION. POL-RD-07(ii) would let the impaired trace be carried by an independent source. There is no driver admission in the chat log (EV-CHAT-02850 holds 0 messages, first and last message times null), and no charged gantry placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use (EV-FARE-02850 charges no gantry; tolls_erp 0.00). The driver's statement, 'Navigation rerouted me.', concedes at most that a reroute occurred; it names no road, corridor or distance, and it cannot stand in for the traffic advisory that does not exist, so under POL-RD-08 it discharges nothing and under POL-RD-13 it exonerates nothing. I have also read it at its highest for the rider, as a counterparty statement admitting the route — and the case still escalates, because that statement is not an instrument artifact carrying a weight_multiplier, so it cannot lift the 0.60 cap, and POL-RD-10(1) still fires. On the other reading there is no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration at all, and POL-RD-10(3) escalates directly. Either way the result is the same, and the rider's own alternative claim (that absent corroboration the outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION) is consequently accepted.

WHAT I DID NOT DO. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. The driver cited no advisory identifier, so the absence is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, and POL-RD-13 confirms that reading. The rider's claims that POL-RD-03 is unavailable and that the traffic assertion is weightless are accepted. POL-RD-04 does not run: EV-CHAT-02850 holds no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint. POL-RD-05 does not run: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null. POL-RD-12 does not run: the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. POL-RD-11 does not run: fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null. POL-RD-09 adds nothing to any figure: no ERP, no tolls and no surcharge (all 0.00). POL-RD-06 produces nothing against the driver — deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 417 completed trips, so no pattern is established, no FULL_REFUND uplift follows, and no conduct referral is licensed; POL-GEN-01 also barred the lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags from that test. POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity is not engaged. The rider's claim that no POL-RD-10 trigger would fire is rejected for the reason given above; the referrals list is empty because no clause produces a referral on these facts.

THE ARITHMETIC, FOR THE REVIEWER. Had the case been decidable, POL-RD-02 would give: charged_total 26.73; recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0, the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, + 0.80 platform fee = 20.42; refund = 26.73 - 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to SGD 6.35 — a PARTIAL_REFUND above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and well under 90% of charged_total. That figure, rider, is the figure your own claim computed and it is arithmetically right; it simply cannot issue while the confidence is capped at 0.60. The monetary effect (SGD 6.35) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, but that is academic on a terminal escalation.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. What the record needs is a clean GPS export that fills or corrects the 22:07:31-22:09:11 gap, a driver admission in the chat log, or a traffic advisory covering the trip window. Any of those would let the case be decided on the money rather than sent for review.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
